events.title: Gustav Vasa crowned King of Sweden at Uppsala
events.description: Five years after his election ended the Kalmar Union with Denmark, Gustav I was crowned in Uppsala Cathedral. He went on to build a strong hereditary monarchy and introduce the Lutheran Reformation.
events.html: Five years after his election ended the Kalmar Union with Denmark, Gustav I was crowned in Uppsala Cathedral. He went on to build a strong hereditary monarchy and introduce the Lutheran Reformation.

events.title: Empress Elizabeth founds Moscow University
events.description: Empress Elizabeth signed the decree founding Moscow University, proposed by Ivan Shuvalov and Mikhail Lomonosov (12 January Old Style). Russia's oldest university now bears Lomonosov's name.
events.html: Empress Elizabeth signed the decree founding Moscow University, proposed by Ivan Shuvalov and Mikhail Lomonosov (12 January Old Style). Russia's oldest university now bears Lomonosov's name.

events.title: Aeronautical Society of Great Britain founded
events.description: The society, later the Royal Aeronautical Society, was founded in London to study flight decades before the first aeroplane. It is the oldest aeronautical society in the world.
events.html: The society, later the Royal Aeronautical Society, was founded in London to study flight decades before the first aeroplane. It is the oldest aeronautical society in the world.

events.title: First long-distance radio message sent from the Eiffel Tower
events.description: A transmitter on the Eiffel Tower sent a wireless message over a record distance. The tower's value for military radio helped secure its future after its original 20-year permit.
events.html: A transmitter on the Eiffel Tower sent a wireless message over a record distance. The tower's value for military radio helped secure its future after its original 20-year permit.

events.title: Hattie Caraway becomes the first woman elected to the US Senate
events.description: Appointed to succeed her late husband, Hattie Caraway of Arkansas won a special election to keep the seat. She went on to win two full terms and served until 1945.
events.html: Appointed to succeed her late husband, Hattie Caraway of Arkansas won a special election to keep the seat. She went on to win two full terms and served until 1945.

events.title: Red Army launches the Vistula-Oder Offensive
events.description: Soviet forces burst out of their bridgeheads in Poland and advanced some 500 km in under three weeks. By early February they stood on the Oder, about 70 km from Berlin.
events.html: Soviet forces burst out of their bridgeheads in Poland and advanced some 500 km in under three weeks. By early February they stood on the Oder, about 70 km from Berlin.

events.title: Biafra announces its surrender, ending the Nigerian Civil War
events.description: Biafra's acting leader Philip Effiong announced the end of the secessionist state's resistance. Between half a million and two million people had died, many from famine caused by the blockade.
events.html: Biafra's acting leader Philip Effiong announced the end of the secessionist state's resistance. Between half a million and two million people had died, many from famine caused by the blockade.

events.title: Catastrophic earthquake strikes Haiti
events.description: A magnitude 7.0 earthquake hit near Port-au-Prince, destroying much of the capital. Estimates of the dead range from about 100,000 to over 300,000, and more than a million people were left homeless.
